name: @theiceji/hq-agents
description: HQ Agents: routines the owner schedules (cron in a timezone, a playbook, the modules a run may use, an outside MCP agent or HQ's builtin runner), queued as ops tasks by the ops tick; the proposals a run leaves for the Inbox, accepted through the hq-core target registry (auto-accept only for notes and prompt variants); runs with their cost and tokens, charged against the operating policy's budget. Framework-free; on @theiceji/hq-ops and @theiceji/hq-core.
